scope.flow: Dynamic swap fee calculation and application via DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee()
scope.environment: On-chain AMM factory with dynamic fee module

statements.text: The dynamic fee mechanism should remain effective, applying dynamically calculated fees rather than always falling back to basic tick spacing fees.
The dynamic fee system contains a cconflicting fee caps between `DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee()` and `CLFactory.getSwapFee()` which renders the dynamic fee mechanism ineffective.

ambiguities: Report does not state who triggers the fee calculation or whether it is permissionless.
Report does not specify a concrete numeric dynamic fee value above 10% used in a scenario.
Whether the fallback fee is exactly 100,000 or the tick spacing default is not fully specified.
